## Checks run

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_site.py`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `node --check assets/js/site.js` (when JavaScript changed)
- [ ] Jekyll build and generated HTML check (when available)

## Content and rights review

- [ ] New material is original or its source, permission, and attribution are recorded.
- [ ] Time-sensitive claims have a reliable source and last-checked date.
- [ ] Searchable content has complete metadata and an honest review status.
- [ ] No secrets or private student information are included.
